text: At a Monday afternoon briefing in East Kelm, Baywater health officer Dr. Mira Venn said the withdrawn Zenthora cough syrup contains guaifenol, the ingredient now at the center of the recall. I was told the product had been pulled from shelves after pharmacists reported a bitter smell and unusual sediment in several bottles. At Harrow Street Pharmacy, owner Len Otis showed me one unopened carton stamped with a March 2026 lot number and said he had stopped selling it immediately after the alert came through. Venn said the lab test confirmed guaifenol as the active ingredient and advised residents to return any remaining bottles to the point of sale for a full refund.
